mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 2% over two consecutive quarters signals a restrictive monetary stance that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when this trigger is met, or the trigger fires but returns are not statistically different from baseline (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over three consecutive months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the trigger is not followed by statistically significant negative returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive quarters signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower during triggered episodes compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.10), or the mechanism fails when GDP growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for five consecutive months indicates supply-side stress, which raises input costs and reduces profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month moving average for five consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods, or the statistical significance of the effect is not robust (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp reduction in the federal funds rate below 0.5% during a recession signals an aggressive easing cycle that boosts risk asset valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05), or the trigger fires but returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal savings (RSAFS) and a decline in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over three consecutive months signals a precautionary savings behavior that foreshadows weaker demand and lower earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises and GDPC1 falls for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10), or the effect reverses when inflation is rising rapidly.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in payroll employment growth above 300k per month for three consecutive months signals a strong labor market expansion that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 300k for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05), or the effect is absent during periods of high inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the consumer price index above 4% for six consecutive months signals high inflation, which erodes real earnings and increases discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10), or the effect is reversed when monetary policy is aggressively tightening.
